notes.text:
This UK 180 gram issue has the logos on the front cover.
The sleeve is heavier weight card than the UK 'K' prefix issue and is internally glue-tabbed to the back cover.
The 'K' sleeve does not have cover logos & is internally glue-tabbed to the front cover.
